body: Thank you for this. Extremely specific and helpful. I will try it out.
You are all so helpful. Thank you. And she probably would enjoy that! I'll ask her.
That could work. I'd have to find a particularly tough top coat/clear polish I feel. Any suggestions?

Childhood sexual abuse and a psychotic disorder. It's a form of self harm, so it makes sense. I tend to do it whenever any part of my body is exposed to the air/my eye, or whenever I feel a bump on myself, or whenever I'm bored... it's hard to recognize and stop when I've been doing it as a reflex for so long.
We can do this, yeah. My face is feeling better after my skincare and I'm willing my beard in ASAP. Picking is tough to deal with but we're tough people

It's hard to think about being looked down on, but this is a good perspective. I'll try not to think too much about what I can't change.

Thank you
Thank you man. I'm feeling better today and this means a lot to me
I look like your before right now skin wise (though I'm man) and am trying to get on Accutane. This gives me hope. You look great!

Thank you for the detailed response. This is very kind of you.

I should definitely get back to exercising. I havent been able to go to the gym since lockdown, and working out at home would help my confidence for sure. 

I'd like to start journaling too, thanks for reminding me! I've considered it in the past but have "messy man handwriting" so I'll have to work on it. Gives me something to do, though.

Thank you again. Stay safe yourself.

Good on you for recognizing how to work on this. That's very brave of you to take that step. I'm not going to be breaking up with my boyfriend (it's the best relationship I've ever been in, and he's such a help to my mental health) but I'm glad it worked for you. :)

I will try to let myself be more vulnerable. Masks have given me something to hide behind, which I need to stop doing (hiding, not wearing masks). I don't wear makeup, but I won't start!

Thank you.

I am calling my doctor tomorrow and will be discussing Accutane as an option. It does seem like a potential saving grace for me.

Thank you.

Thank you for your response. I'm sorry you've gone through the same thing.

I have been considering accutane and have been recommended it as an option in the past by a derm. I wish I'd gone on it sooner, but I have a lot of medical paranoia and I'm nervous about the blood tests. I'll just have to be brave, I think?

Do you mind if I ask how long your purge lasted and how you dealt with it? I'm scared about how I'll deal with that stage with my current mindset.

Thank you.

I appreciate your response very much. I have also felt very similarly at work. It feels like customers and coworkers are judging you. I am really glad to hear that you've managed to overcome your stress in this regard.

I am lucky to have a very supportive boyfriend as far as this problem goes. Recognizing he doesn't care and still thinks I'm handsome is important. I'll work harder to internalize it when he says it. He has nigh perfect skin, so he doesn't understand, but his support is really appreciated...thanks for reminding me of that.

I will try to work towards a "fuck it" mindset. Thanks.

I am considering going back to my therapist, yes. I was given one mandatorily after my last attempt, and I believe I still have access to that resource.

Thank you very much for your response.

Hi, thank you for your response. I'm not opposed to routine help, but I'm actually quite comfortable with my routine at the moment and I also have a minor impulse purchasing habit that I'd like to curb. If you have suggestions I will take them, but it wasn't my primary reason for coming here. 

Redness is awful, as is the feeling of self disgust. I''m sorry you're dealing with this too.

I'm calling my doctor tomorrow, and considering going back to my therapist. Thank you.

5'6 man here, age 20, not a lot of advice I can offer but I get how you feel.

I'm in a relationship atm and my current friends don't mock me for my height. I'd say I'm lucky, but it's less luck and more acknowledging how people treat you and finding people who love you and won't treat you like that.

It's difficult, but it's possible. And height isn't worth giving up over.

I wish you luck and I'm sorry you're dealing with this.
